answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because oasis only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any dawn approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
